_readme: Models the owner saved on MakerWorld that the catalogue has not imported yet.
sync-collections.mjs reads this alongside the collections themselves, so a
model can be queued from anywhere — including a machine that can reach the
collection pages when the nightly job cannot. Ids are removed from here as
soon as they land in lib/imported.generated.ts.
`collection` is only a hint: it decides the shelf when its name is explicit
(flexi, fidget, statue). Anything else is classified from the model itself.
